summary_en: 82,000 shares (1.14% S/O ex-treasury) to be acquired for up to ¥150.0M via open-market purchase including ToSTNeT-3, Aug 3–Dec 31, 2026. Authorized by board on Jul 31, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision on Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: Toyo Wharf & Warehouse has resolved by board decision on July 31, 2026, to acquire up to 82,000 shares (1.14% of shares outstanding excluding treasury, on a base of 7,191,150) for an aggregate maximum of ¥150.0 million. Acquisition will occur via open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, including ToSTNeT-3 transactions, between August 3 and December 31, 2026. The company states the buyback is intended to enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency as part of its capital policy, and to achieve appropriate market valuation. The board has delegated implementation authority to the representative director.
